description: Three-turn conversation where customer clarifies their issue across multiple turns before agent retrieves the relevant answer

turns.message: I have a problem with my order.
It arrived damaged. The bag was torn open.
I want to know if I can get a replacement or refund.

human_label_notes: Customer progressively reveals damaged item scenario across 3 turns. Return Policy covers defective/damaged items with immediate replacement. Agent should retrieve and cite the damaged goods clause.
